Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 30, 2026
Last Updated: October 30, 2026

ARENA USA ("we", "us", "our", or "the Service") is an AI-powered digital media platform operated by ARENA USA Technology. We are committed to protecting your privacy and complying with all applicable U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act ("CCPA"), the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act ("COPPA"), the CAN-SPAM Act, and similar state privacy statutes in Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, and other jurisdictions.

This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and the choices and rights you have regarding your data.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information in the following categories. The specific categories of personal information we collect under the CCPA are listed in Section 11 (CCPA Disclosure).

1.1 Information You Provide Directly

  • Account information: When you register as an editor or administrator, we collect your email address, name, and a password (stored as a PBKDF2 hash, never in plaintext).
  • Article submissions: If you submit content through our public API or admin panel, we collect the article title, body text, source URL, cover image, and metadata you provide.
  • Image uploads: When you upload cover images via the admin panel, we store the image file (or a URL to it) along with alt text for accessibility.
  • Password reset requests: If you request a password reset, we generate a one-time token (hashed with SHA-256) that is valid for 1 hour and sent to your email address.
  • Advertising inquiries: If you contact us about advertising, we collect your name, email address, company, and campaign details.
  • Donation information: We display cryptocurrency wallet addresses for donations. We do not collect or store donor information — transactions occur directly on the blockchain. We may display a public thank-you list of wallet addresses that have donated, but we do not link wallets to individuals.

1.2 Information Collected Automatically

  • Usage data: When you visit our site, we collect your IP address, browser type, device type, referring URL, pages viewed, and time spent on pages. We use this to count active visitors (displayed in the header) and to understand aggregate traffic patterns.
  • Cookies and similar technologies: We use a single essential cookie (arena_session) to maintain your logged-in session if you are an administrator. This cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Lax. We do not use third-party tracking cookies, advertising cookies, or social media cookies.
  • Server logs: Our hosting provider (Vercel) and database provider (Neon) automatically log request metadata (IP, timestamp, user agent, URL). These logs are retained for 30 days for security and debugging purposes.

1.3 Information Collected from Third Parties

We may receive aggregated, non-personal information from third-party data providers we use to display real-time market data (CoinGecko), weather forecasts (Open-Meteo), and U.S. holiday calendars (Nager.Date). This information is not linked to your identity.

If you make a payment through Stripe for advertising, Stripe will collect and process your payment card information directly. We do not see or store your card number — we only receive a confirmation that the payment was successful. See Stripe's Privacy Policy.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the personal information we collect for the following business purposes:

  • To operate, maintain, and improve our website and services (including displaying articles, counting active visitors, and personalizing weather by location).
  • To create and manage editor/administrator accounts and to authenticate your session.
  • To process and publish articles submitted through our API or admin panel, including AI-assisted classification, summarization, and duplicate detection.
  • To send you transactional emails (such as password reset links) when you request them. We do not send marketing emails unless you explicitly opt in.
  • To process advertising orders and payments through Stripe, and to manage advertising campaigns.
  • To detect, prevent, and address technical issues, fraud, security incidents, and violations of our Terms of Service.
  • To comply with our legal obligations under U.S. federal and state laws, including record-keeping for audit purposes.
  • To publish aggregated, de-identified analytics about visitor counts and popular categories.

AI processing notice: We use AI models to classify and summarize article content. Article text submitted through our API is processed by these models to generate a title, summary, category, and sensitivity flags. We do not use your personal information (such as your email or IP address) for AI training.

3. Legal Basis for Processing (Applicable Laws)

We process personal information under the following legal bases, depending on the applicable jurisdiction:

  • CCPA (California): We collect and use personal information for the business and commercial purposes described above, as permitted by Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100 et seq.
  • VCDPA (Virginia), CPA (Colorado), CTDPA (Connecticut), UCPA (Utah): We process personal data for the purposes described in this Policy, consistent with the consumer rights granted under these state privacy statutes.
  • COPPA (Children under 13): Our service is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us and we will delete it.
  • CAN-SPAM Act: We do not send commercial email without your consent. Transactional emails (password resets) comply with CAN-SPAM requirements and include a way to contact us.
  • Consent: For activities that require affirmative consent (such as marketing emails), we obtain your explicit opt-in before processing.

4. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We do not rent or trade your data. We share information only in the following limited circumstances:

  • Service providers: We share data with the third-party service providers listed in Section 5 who help us operate the site. Each provider is bound by their own privacy policy and is contractually limited to using your data only to provide services to us.
  • Legal compliance: We may disclose information when required by law, subpoena, court order, or government request, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of ARENA USA, our users, or others.
  • Business transfers: If ARENA USA is involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred. We will notify you by email or prominent notice on the site 30 days before any change in ownership or use of your information.
  • Aggregate/de-identified data: We may share aggregated, de-identified statistics about visitors (such as total monthly views or popular categories) with partners or the public. This data cannot be used to identify you.

6. Data Retention

We retain personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this Policy:

  • Account information: Retained until you request deletion or your account is inactive for 24 months.
  • Article content: Published articles are retained for 48 hours in the public feed, then moved to the archive. Archived articles are retained indefinitely unless an administrator deletes them. Articles marked "Pinned forever" remain in the public feed indefinitely.
  • Visitor session data: Active visitor sessions are retained for 60 seconds (heartbeat TTL). Inactive session records are retained for 24 hours for analytics, then automatically deleted.
  • Audit logs: Retained for 24 months for security and legal compliance, then automatically deleted.
  • Password reset tokens: Valid for 1 hour only, then automatically invalidated.
  • API keys: Retained until you disable or delete them through the admin panel. Usage tracking (last used, total calls) is retained for the life of the key.
  • Server logs (Vercel, Neon): Retained for 30 days by our hosting providers for security and debugging.
  • Payment records: Retained for 7 years per U.S. tax record requirements (29 CFR § 516.5). Stripe retains payment card data per their own policy — we only store campaign metadata.

7. Data Security

We implement industry-standard technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information:

  • Encryption in transit: All traffic uses HTTPS with TLS 1.3. HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security) is enabled with max-age=63072000 and includeSubDomains.
  • Encryption at rest: Database (Neon Postgres) is encrypted at rest with AES-256. Backups are encrypted.
  • Password hashing: Admin passwords are hashed with PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations, SHA-256, 16-byte salt). We never store plaintext passwords.
  • Session tokens: Session tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes in the database, never in plaintext. If the database is compromised, stolen tokens cannot be reused.
  • API keys: Stored as SHA-256 hashes. Raw API keys are shown only once at creation and never retrievable again.
  • Timing-safe comparisons: All credential comparisons (login, API key verification, cron secret) use constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.
  • Rate limiting: Login attempts, API calls, and visitor heartbeats are rate-limited to prevent brute-force and DoS attacks.
  • Content Security Policy (CSP): Admin pages enforce a strict CSP restricting script sources.
  • SSRF protection: User-supplied image URLs are validated against a private-IP allowlist to prevent server-side request forgery.
  • Access controls: Admin panel access requires authenticated session with admin or editor role. All admin actions are logged in an audit trail.
  • Magic-bytes verification: Image uploads are verified by file content (not just Content-Type header) to prevent malicious file uploads.

Despite these measures, no system is 100% secure. If we become aware of a security breach affecting your personal information, we will notify affected users within 72 hours, as required by state breach notification laws (e.g., Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.82).

8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use only essential cookies. We do not use advertising cookies, social media tracking pixels, or third-party analytics cookies.

Cookie namePurposeDurationCategory
arena_sessionMaintains your logged-in session (admin panel only)7 daysStrictly necessary

Because we only use strictly-necessary cookies, we do not display a cookie consent banner. Most browsers allow you to manage cookies in their settings — see Chrome, Firefox, Safari. Disabling cookies will prevent you from logging in to the admin panel but will not affect your ability to read articles.

9. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your state of residence, you may have the following rights under U.S. privacy laws:

9.1 Rights Under CCPA / CPRA (California)

California residents have the right to:

  • Know what personal information we have collected about you in the past 12 months (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.110, § 1798.115).
  • Delete your personal information, with certain exceptions (§ 1798.105).
  • Correct inaccurate personal information (§ 1798.106).
  • Opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal information (§ 1798.120, § 1798.121). We do not sell or share your data, so this right is automatically respected — no opt-out is needed.
  • Limit the use of sensitive personal information (§ 1798.121). We do not collect sensitive personal information beyond what is strictly necessary.
  • Non-discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your privacy rights (§ 1798.125).

9.2 Rights Under VCDPA, CPA, CTDPA, UCPA (VA, CO, CT, UT)

Residents of Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, and Utah have the right to:

  • Access and obtain a copy of their personal data.
  • Correct inaccuracies in their personal data.
  • Delete their personal data (with exceptions for data needed to complete a transaction or comply with law).
  • Obtain their data in a portable, readily usable format.
  • Opt out of targeted advertising, sale of personal data, and certain profiling.
  • Appeal a denial of a privacy rights request.

9.3 COPPA (Children Under 13)

Our service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn we have collected such information, we will delete it promptly. Parents who believe we have collected information from their child can contact us at privacy@arena-usa.com.

9.4 How to Exercise Your Rights

To exercise any of the rights above, please contact us at privacy@arena-usa.com with the subject line "Privacy Rights Request" and include:

  • Your name and email address
  • The specific right you wish to exercise (e.g., "I want to delete my account")
  • Proof of identity (we may request additional verification)

We will respond to your request within 45 days (CCPA requires response within 45 days; VCDPA/CPA/CTDPA within 45 days; UCPA within 45 days). If we need more time, we will inform you of the reason and extension period (up to 45 additional days).

Authorized agents: You may designate an authorized agent to make requests on your behalf by providing a signed permission letter. We may still require you to verify your identity directly.

10. Opt-Out of "Sale" or "Sharing"

We do not sell your personal information, as "sell" is defined under CCPA (§ 1798.140(ad)) and similar state laws. We also do not "share" your personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising.

Because we do not engage in these practices, there is no opt-out link or "Do Not Sell My Personal Information" button on our site. If our practices change, we will update this Policy and provide an opt-out mechanism at least 30 days before the change takes effect.

Do Not Track signals: Our site does not respond to "Do Not Track" signals from your browser because we do not engage in cross-site tracking. We respect your choice not to be tracked.

12. International Users

ARENA USA is operated from the United States and is intended for users in the United States. If you access our site from outside the U.S., your information will be transferred to the U.S. and processed under U.S. laws.

GDPR (European Economic Area, UK, Switzerland): If you are located in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland, you have additional rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), including the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, port your data, object to processing, and withdraw consent. The legal basis for our processing is legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) for operating the website, contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) for account services, and consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) for marketing (when you opt in). To exercise GDPR rights, contact us at privacy@arena-usa.com. We do not have a designated EU representative.

We do not knowingly direct our service to users in jurisdictions where its provision would violate local law.

13. Minors

Our service is not directed to individuals under 13 years of age (under 16 for California residents under CCPA). We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at privacy@arena-usa.com and we will delete the information within 30 days.

Parents may review and delete their child's information by following the verification process described in Section 9.

14. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or applicable laws. When we do, we will revise the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page.

If we make material changes that affect your rights (such as new data uses or sharing with new categories of third parties), we will notify you by email (if we have your email) and post a prominent notice on the homepage at least 30 days before the change takes effect.

You can review the history of this Policy on our GitHub repository.

15. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact us:

ARENA USA Technology

Response time: We aim to respond within 5 business days. For urgent privacy requests (such as data deletion), we respond within 45 days as required by applicable law.
